description: This file implements functions and classes for managing, serializing, deserializing, and restoring a disk cache index file in a Chromium-based project. It handles reading/writing index data, CRC checks, and index file state management.

classes.name: SimpleIndexPickle
classes.description: A subclass of base::Pickle with additional header validation for index serialization.

classes.name: SimpleIndexFile::IndexMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about the index file, including version, reason, entry count, and cache size, with serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: CalculatePickleCRC
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of a pickle payload.

methods.name: WritePickleFile
methods.description: Writes pickle data to a file using provided file operations.

methods.name: ProcessEntryFile
methods.description: Processes a cache entry file during index restoration, updating the entries set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes index metadata and entries into a pickle object.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes pickle data into index metadata and entries, validating CRC.

methods.name: SyncLoadFromDisk
methods.description: Loads index data from disk, validating size and CRC, and deserializing.

methods.name: SyncRestoreFromDisk
methods.description: Reconstructs index entries by enumerating cache directory files.

methods.name: LoadIndexEntries
methods.description: Asynchronously loads index entries from disk.

methods.name: WriteToDisk
methods.description: Serializes index data and writes it atomically to disk.
